language.title: Language & voice
language.description: Set the languages EcoVibes should prioritize as local support grows.
language.preferredHelp: Used as your default language preference for future search, discovery and localized experiences.
language.contentHelp: Choose up to six languages you want to see represented in your discovery preferences.
language.regionHelp: Helps EcoVibes use the right regional variant when localized support is available.
language.voiceHelp: These capabilities are shown honestly by language. A saved preference does not enable a microphone or send audio.
language.directoryHelp: English is the current interface language. Other language selections save your preference; they do not translate the interface yet.
language.deviceSave: Saved on this device. Sign in to sync this preference across devices.
language.offline: Saved on this device. Change a preference after reconnecting to retry account sync.
language.waiting: Waiting for your account session before syncing.
language.noMic: Selecting a voice preference does not request microphone permission or activate voice features.
language.savedHere: Your language choices are preferences only; translation and voice support are not active yet.
